item.text: I’ll trace the existing permission rules and project service patterns, then add the dedicated schema and operation with validation ordered so rejected calls never change the lead.

The permission and schema changes are in place. I’ve added a separate repository write and am tightening the service checks now; new leads are looked up through the organization-scoped active-membership query before any write.
